player_prompt.intro:
Yin e raan {player_id} ee Connect Four.
Raan ee raan kɛɛl: {symbol}.
Kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n {num_rows} ku kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n {num_cols}.
Raan aɣɛɛ̈ɛ̈n ciɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛɛ̈ɛ̈n (0 ku {end_col}).
Raan ee ciɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n (kɛɛlɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n) kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kuɛ̈ɛ̈n, kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n, ku kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n.
Yin e raan, kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n.
Kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛ̈ɛ̈n: '[col 4]' ku '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Kä ji̱ ŋarä /ca kɛ nɛn ɛ nɛy tin la ŋa̱a̱ri.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cɛɛk nhɛ̈k. Kuɔl {col} ee kɛ̈ kɔ̈k.
invalid_move.already_full: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cɛɛk nhɛ̈k. Kuɔl {col} ee full.

action.dropped_disk: Riäŋ {player_id} thok kuɔl de ({player_symbol}) thɛ̈ɛ̈r kuɔl {col}.

outcome.draw: Ɛn ŋar cɛ thuɔ̱k kɛ mi ci nɛy diaal ɛ wɔ̱.
